name: vibewars
description: A minimalist, browser-based, GW1-inspired competitive PvP arena game.

scripts.typecheck: tsc --build tsconfig.build.json && tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit && pnpm -r exec tsc -p tsconfig.json --noEmit
scripts.clean: git clean -xdf node_modules dist .tsbuildinfo && pnpm -r exec rm -rf dist node_modules
scripts.ci: pnpm run format:check && pnpm run lint && pnpm run typecheck && pnpm run test && pnpm run build
scripts.ci:full: pnpm run ci && pnpm run test:e2e
